login.title: Sign in
col.name: Name
devices.title: Devices
newdev.title: Add device
newdev.desc: On add, ROSMan connects over API-SSL, pins the certificate fingerprint (TOFU) and reads identity/version.
newdev.name: Name (empty — use identity)
newdev.sshuser: SSH user (for /export; empty — same as API)
svc.title: Services
svc.name: Name
fire.title: Firewall
fire.note: The rule is applied under change-guard (auto-rollback): a backup is taken and a timer armed before the change; if the device becomes unreachable it restores the backup itself.
fire.confirm: Add firewall rule? Auto-rollback will be armed.
sec.title: Security (CVE)
sec.clean: all devices clean against this dataset
sec.dbnote: Checked against a built-in curated RouterOS CVE dataset (offline). Not a substitute for MikroTik's advisories; a clean result means 'no match in the dataset', not a guarantee.
cve.title: CVE
cve.none: No vulnerabilities for this version in the built-in dataset.
cve.dbnote: RouterOS version checked against a built-in curated CVE dataset (offline). The authoritative source is MikroTik's advisories.
cve.fixhint: Recommendation: upgrade RouterOS to at least the listed version (Firmware tab).
acc.title: Account
acc.2fa_on: 2FA is enabled. Sign-in requires a code from your authenticator app.
acc.2fa_off: 2FA is off. Enable it to protect sign-in with an authenticator code.
acc.2fa_scan: Scan the QR in your app (Google Authenticator, Aegis, 1Password) and enter a code to confirm.
acc.tokens_note: Personal tokens for the JSON API (read-only). Keep them like a password.
acc.token_once: Copy it now — the token is shown only once.
tool.title: Tools
tool.note: Diagnostics run on the device itself (RouterOS) and change nothing in its config.
maint.title: Maintenance windows
maint.note: During an active window, alert notifications for the device are not sent (alert state is still recorded). A window can target one device or the whole fleet.
usr.title: Panel users
usr.roles_hint: viewer — read-only; operator — device changes; admin — full access and user management.
lte.legend: RSRP: ≥ -90 dBm good, -90 to -105 fair, below -105 poor.
lte.none: No LTE interfaces found on this device.
hist.title: History
hist.none: No data yet for the selected range.
git.title: Config export to git
git.note: Each device's latest /export is written to files in a git repo and committed on every backup cycle (and on demand), building a history of config changes.
git.now_note: One-off commit of the current configs to the repo.
bulk.title: Bulk operations
bulk.confirm: Run the action on the selected devices?
bulk.tpl_note: The template and rollback window apply only to the "Apply template" action (under auto-rollback).
dev.del_confirm: Delete this device from ROSMan? Its poll data and config history will be removed.
cron.title: Scheduler
cron.name: Name
cron.note: Jobs run from the scheduler. 'Interval' — every N minutes; 'Daily' — at the given time (optionally on a specific weekday). Template and rollback window apply only to the 'Apply template' action.
disc.title: Discovered neighbours
disc.note: Combined list of devices seen over MNDP/LLDP (/ip/neighbor) across all managed devices. New ones can be added to ROSMan with one click.
comp.title: Config compliance
comp.note: Rules are checked against each device's latest stored /export. 'require' — the config must contain the text; 'forbid' — must not; *_re — the same with a regular expression.
map.title: Map
map.legend: One marker per location: green — all devices online, orange — some offline, red — all offline, grey — no devices. Click a marker for the device list.
map.none: No locations have coordinates yet. Set latitude/longitude on the Locations page.
site.geo_hint: Latitude/longitude in decimal degrees (e.g. 55.751, 37.618). Empty fields clear it.
ret.title: Metrics retention
ret.note: Old graph samples (CPU/memory/temperature) are deleted once a day. Config history and the audit log are not affected.
ret.now_note: One-off deletion of samples older than the retention window.
imp.title: Import from CSV
imp.note: Paste CSV: columns ip,api_user,api_pass,name,api_port,ssh_user. The first three are required; name/port/ssh are optional (port=8729, ssh=api_user). A header row is detected automatically. Each device is probed and its certificate pinned (TOFU).
rep.title: Reports
rep.note: Fleet report: inventory, status, firmware, CVEs.
rep.pdf_hint: The printable version opens in a new tab — save it as PDF via your browser's print (Cmd/Ctrl+P → "Save as PDF").
wh.title: Webhooks
wh.note: ROSMan POSTs JSON to the URL on an event. Headers: X-ROSMan-Event and (if a secret is set) X-ROSMan-Signature: sha256=HMAC.
wh.events_hint: Events: all, alert (device alerts), config_changed (new config version). Comma-separated.
diff.title: Config comparison
diff.restore_confirm: Restore this version? A binary backup reboots the device; an export is applied on top under change-guard.
set.title: Settings
fw.title: Firmware
fw.confirm: The upgrade will reboot devices. Continue?
fw.note: Each device is backed up first; the canary runs first, halt on failure.
fw.refresh_note: Refresh the page to see progress.
cfg.title: Config
au.title: Audit log
tpl.title: Config templates
tpl.guard_note: Changes are protected by auto-rollback: a backup is taken and a timer armed before applying; if the device becomes unreachable after the change it restores the backup itself.
tpl.name: Name
tpl.confirm: Apply template? Auto-rollback will be armed.
cl.none: No clients yet — wait for a poll.
site.title: Locations
site.name: Name
topo.title: Network topology
topo.empty: No data — add devices and wait for a poll.
topo.legend: Green — online, red — unreachable, grey — unknown. Links are built from MNDP/LLDP neighbours between known devices.
dev.snmp_note: SNMP v2c. Readings (CPU/memory/temperature) feed the same graphs. The device needs SNMP enabled: /snmp set enabled=yes and a community.
dev.faceplate_legend: Green — link up, grey — port up without link, dim — disabled. Hover a port for its name.
dev.faceplate_none: No port data yet — wait for a poll.
dev.traffic_empty: Not enough data yet — needs at least two polls.
ca.title: Certificate Authority
ca.none: No CA configured. Generate a new one or import an existing CA.
ca.regen_warn: Replacing the CA does not revoke already-issued certificates.
run.title: Command runner
run.subtitle: Run ad-hoc RouterOS commands on selected devices
run.no_ssh: No SSH key configured (ROSMAN_SSH_KEY) — the command runner needs SSH.
run.cmd_note: RouterOS CLI, run over SSH. One or more commands (one per line). Output is captured per device.
run.guard_note: For config-changing commands: a binary backup is reloaded if the device stops answering.
run.confirm: Run the command on the selected devices?
cs.title: Config search
cs.subtitle: Search a string or regex across the latest stored config of every device
cs.note: Searches the newest /export snapshot of each device (updated on backup). Matching lines are shown with line numbers.
cron.command_note: Used only when the action is Run command. Runs over SSH on the target devices; set a guard above to auto-roll-back a config change that cuts access.
net.title: Network
set.test_note: Sends a test message to the configured Telegram / SMTP (using the values above).
topo.drag_hint: drag nodes to arrange — the layout is saved; click a node to open it
img.notes_ph: Notes for colleagues — rack position, quirks, anything worth knowing…
topo.not_found: Not found in any device's clients/neighbours
port.title: Ports — what's connected
port.note: from the bridge FDB, MNDP neighbours and the client table
thr.title: Alert thresholds
thr.note: Raise a warning alert when a poll exceeds these. Empty or 0 disables the check.
